newsitem.title: USA: Belden & Blake issues $225 mln 144a debt.
newsitem.headline: Belden & Blake issues $225 mln 144a debt.

text.p: The following 144a debt issue from Belden & Blake Corp was priced Monday via lead manager Chase Securities, according to market sources.

Proceeds from the deal, in part, will provide for Texas Pacific Group's acquisition of Belden & Blake common shares and retirement of existing debt. Belden & Blake is an oil and gas exploration and production company focused on the Appalachian, Michigan and Illinois basins.
The issue was increased in size by $25 million.
